definitions.ask: Should the capacity scan persist a sticky never-live verdict cache keyed on artifact-dir mtime?
definitions.why: Verdicts are sticky, the archive grows ~4.5k dirs/month, and 26+ runner processes pay cold passes.

choices.label: Warm rescans drop to ~ms for 20k+ dirs; adds one cache file plus invalidation rules to sase-core.
No new persisted state, but every process repays a cold full-archive meta pass (seconds).

definitions.ask: May the soak phase propose a gated restart of Bryan's live tmux TUI session after the soak passes?
definitions.why: Bryan may be using the session, and stale_running_code.py already surfaces the restart row.

choices.label: Soak a dedicated TUI instance only; Bryan restarts his own session when convenient.
After a passing soak, propose a gated quit-and-relaunch of the live session.
